concerns.text: FR-004 (Extract network metrics) lacks a dedicated task. While T017 implements 'metric extraction', it is not explicitly tagged [FR-004] and its description focuses on writing to the manifest rather than the explicit extraction logic required by the spec. A distinct task or explicit tag is needed to ensure FR-004 coverage.

FR-005 (Linear and non-linear regression) is partially covered by T033, but the spec explicitly requires 'non-linear' regression. T033 description only mentions 'linear and non-linear' generically without detailing the non-linear implementation (e.g., polynomial, exponential). T057 (Partial Correlation) and T058 (Ridge) are tagged [FR-005] but are specific techniques, not the general non-linear regression requirement. A specific task for non-linear regression implementation is missing.

FR-006 (Multiple-comparison correction) is covered by T034b and T071, but T071 is tagged [FR-006] while T034b is not. T034b implements Bonferroni and BH, but the spec requires the system to 'apply' the correction. T079 implements the selector but is tagged [FR-005] (incorrectly) or untagged for FR-006. The coverage for FR-006 is fragmented and lacks a clear 'apply correction' task tagged [FR-006].

FR-010 (Complete 100 time steps within 60 mins) is a performance constraint. T070 profiles CPU time, and T026b enforces timeout, but there is no task explicitly tagged [FR-010] or described as 'Verify 100 steps < 60 mins' in the context of the full pipeline. T070 is tagged [FR-002][SC-002]. A specific task to validate the FR-010 constraint (e.g., a benchmark task) is missing.

Task T018c appears twice with different descriptions. The first T018c (Phase 3) describes 'iteration logic over topology classes'. The second T018c (Phase 3, near end) describes 'aggregate_batches' and is tagged [FR-004][FR-001]. This duplication and conflicting ID usage creates ambiguity in task coverage and traceability.
Task T079 is tagged [FR-005] but implements 'multiple-comparison correction selector' which belongs to FR-006. This is a stale/incorrect tag that misrepresents the coverage of FR-006 and FR-005.

Task T085 is tagged [FR-002] but implements 'simulation divergence detection' which is an edge case handling for FR-002/SC-002. While related, the spec's Edge Cases section defines this behavior. The tag is acceptable but the task description should explicitly reference the Edge Case to ensure full coverage of the 'abort and flag' requirement.
